text_block_list.text:
This time... we are the winners of this 
race.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Burning with fighting spirit, we raced 
together. Nothing can outshine the 
brilliance of our twin stars.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: All that's left is to go out and prove it.
choice_data_list: Waiting for you in the winner's circle!

text_block_list.text: Yes. I'll rush over right away.
